title: Walking cycle
beats: left heel contact, right toe behind
left weight down, right heel lifts
right foot airborne passing left support leg
right leg extends forward, left heel rises
right heel contact, left toe behind
right weight down, left heel lifts
left foot airborne passing right support leg
left leg extends forward, right heel rises
notes: No workstation or scenery. Natural full-body walk in place with opposite-leg contact poses and counter-swinging arms. Walk carefully supported by wooden walking stick in right hand; coordinate stick plant, weight transfer and recovery.
